'''Echo Seven''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] given to a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Echo Flight]], a [[N-X Police Cruiser/Legends|N-X Police Cruisers]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]].<ref name="The Starfighter Trap">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref>

Echo Seven brought down at least two [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] before being disabled by [[Dren Melne]] during the [[Battle at TFP-9]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="The Starfighter Trap" />
